topics.caution: The proposal covers 'ઝાડ પર ચડ્યો નથી... વાડીએ જઈએ' (climbing trees) and 'ખુલ્લી ટાંકી... ડૂબકી મારીને નાહી શકશો' (diving into an open water tank); the explanation or real_life_example could turn these into things the child is invited to try on their own, dropping the fact that in the text મહેશભાઈ says 'હું તારી સાથે જ હોવાનો ને !' before either happens.
topics.guidance: Keep the adult always present in how tree-climbing and the open-tank swim are explained — say it happens because પપ્પા is right there, and let the real_life_example anchor to a supervised outing (a family visit to a વાડી or pool with a grown-up), never a child trying either alone at home.
